title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.1 Text Alternatives - 1.1.1 Non-text Content
description: Guideline 1.1  Text Alternatives: Provide text alternatives for any non-text content Success Criterion  1.1.1 Non-text Content  (Level A)
steps_actions: Verify functional images (buttons, links) with accessibility inspector
steps_result: Functional images must describe the action or destination, not just the visual image
steps_data: axe-core (wcag111): aria-meter-name, aria-progressbar-name, image-alt, input-image-alt, object-alt, role-img-alt, svg-img-alt

steps_actions: Review complex images (charts, diagrams) and look for extended descriptions
steps_result: Complex images must have accessible long description via longdesc, aria-describedby, or adjacent text

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Inspect prerecorded audio-only and video-only media to verify a text transcript or audio track is provided adjacent to the player
steps_result: Every prerecorded audio-only or video-only clip provides an accessible link or expandable section containing the full text alternative

steps_actions: Verify that transcript includes speaker identification and relevant sounds
steps_result: Transcript must be complete, identify who is speaking, and describe important sounds for comprehension

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Play prerecorded video content with audio and enable closed captions using keyboard and pointer controls
steps_result: Captions are available, can be toggled on/off via accessible controls, and display all dialogue

steps_actions: Verify caption synchronization and accuracy with audio
steps_result: Captions must appear synchronized with audio, without significant errors, covering relevant sound effects

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Play videos with essential visual content and verify descriptions
steps_result: Audio description or text alternative must exist describing important visual information

steps_actions: Verify that alternative covers all critical visual elements for comprehension
steps_result: Description must include actions, expressions, scene changes, and unspoken on-screen text

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.4 Captions (Live)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.4 Captions (Live)
steps_actions: Access live broadcasts if available
steps_result: Live broadcasts must have real-time captioning

steps_actions: Verify accuracy and acceptable delay of live captions
steps_result: Captions must reflect spoken audio with reasonable accuracy and minimal delay (maximum 3-5 seconds)

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Identify prerecorded videos containing essential visual information not conveyed in audio
steps_result: Videos must include audio description covering actions, characters, scene changes, and relevant visual elements

steps_actions: Play video with audio description enabled and verify synchronization
steps_result: Audio description must be inserted in natural pauses without overlapping main audio

steps_actions: Verify that audio description covers all critical visual elements
steps_result: Essential visual information must be fully described for blind or low vision users

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded) General Objective: To verify that pre-recorded video content with audio provides extended audio descriptions when necessary to understand the content. This test case verifies whether a pre-recorded video on the web site provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. Extended audio descriptions provide information about actions, characters, scenes, and on-screen information that cannot be understood from the original audio of the pre-recorded video alone. Expected Result: The pre-recorded video with audio provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. The extended audio descriptions can be activated and provide additional information that is not available in the original audio of the video.
steps_actions: Identify prerecorded audio content (videos with narration or dialogue)
steps_result: Videos must include sign language interpretation visible on screen or activatable

steps_actions: Verify visibility and size of sign language interpreter
steps_result: Interpreter must be clearly visible, with adequate contrast and sufficient size to distinguish signs

steps_actions: Verify synchronization between audio and sign language
steps_result: Sign interpretation must be synchronized with spoken audio without significant delays

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Identify videos where natural pauses are insufficient for audio description
steps_result: Video must automatically pause to allow extended audio description of complex visual information

steps_actions: Play video with extended audio description and verify pauses
steps_result: Video must pause when needed to describe visual elements, then continue automatically

steps_actions: Verify user control over extended audio description
steps_result: User must be able to enable or disable extended audio description per preference

steps_actions: Confirm that extended description does not interfere with content comprehension
steps_result: Pauses and descriptions must integrate naturally without causing confusion or loss of narrative context

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
steps_actions: Locate prerecorded videos and verify availability of complete text document
steps_result: A complete text transcript must exist including dialogues, visual descriptions, and relevant sounds

steps_actions: Review that text alternative describes complete sequence of visual events
steps_result: Document must function as independent alternative, describing all essential visual information chronologically

steps_actions: Verify accessibility of text alternative
steps_result: Transcript must be in accessible format (HTML, structured document) near the original video

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.9 Audio-only (Live)
description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.9 Audio-only (Live)
steps_actions: Access live audio-only broadcast (podcast, web radio, conference)
steps_result: An equivalent alternative must be presented synchronized with the live audio

steps_actions: Verify delivery method of synchronized alternative
steps_result: Alternative can be real-time transcript, synchronized text description, or updated equivalent content

steps_actions: Verify that alternative captures essential information from live audio
steps_result: Text content must reflect critical audio information with minimal acceptable delay

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.1 Info and Relationships
steps_actions: Verify forms with programmatically associated labels
steps_result: Each input must have label with for attribute or be wrapped in label, visible to screen readers
steps_data: axe-core (wcag131): aria-hidden-body, aria-required-children, aria-required-parent, definition-list, dlitem, list, listitem, td-headers-attr, th-has-data-cells, p-as-heading, table-fake-caption, td-has-header

steps_actions: Review related field groups with fieldset and legend
steps_result: Control groups (radio buttons, checkboxes) must be grouped with fieldset and descriptive legend

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence
steps_actions: Navigate the site using only Tab and verify reading order
steps_result: Tab and DOM order must match the logical visual order of content

steps_actions: Use screen reader to verify content reading order
steps_result: Reading order must be logical and coherent, without confusing jumps caused by CSS positioning

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics
steps_actions: Identify instructions that use only shape, color, or position
steps_result: Instructions must include descriptive text in addition to visual references (e.g., 'green Submit button' not just 'green button')

steps_actions: Verify that critical information does not rely solely on sensory elements
steps_result: Errors, alerts, or process steps must be communicated with text in addition to color, icons, or sounds

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.4 Orientation
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.4 Orientation
steps_actions: Rotate the viewport between Portrait (390x844) and Landscape (812x375) orientations and inspect CSS/JS restrictions
steps_result: Content and functionality adapt to both portrait and landscape orientations without CSS rotation locks or screen.orientation.lock() restrictions

steps_actions: Verify that content is not locked to a single orientation
steps_result: Application must not force specific orientation unless essential (e.g., piano app, bank check)

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose
steps_actions: Inspect form fields in source code
steps_result: Common fields (name, email, phone) must have appropriate autocomplete attribute

steps_actions: Test autocomplete with browser saved data
steps_result: Fields with correct autocomplete must suggest user saved values when typing begins

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.6 Identify Purpose
description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.6 Identify Purpose
steps_actions: Review complex UI components and verify programmatic purpose
steps_result: Components must identify their purpose through ARIA attributes or HTML semantics for assistive technologies

steps_actions: Verify icons and interactive elements with accessibility inspector
steps_result: Buttons, links, and icons must expose their function through appropriate roles and accessible names

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.1 Use of Color
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.1 Use of Color
steps_actions: Inspect links within blocks of text, form validation errors, charts, and status indicators to verify non-color visual cues
steps_result: Links in text have underlines or a 3:1 contrast ratio with surrounding text plus a non-color hover/focus indicator, and statuses include icons, patterns, or text labels

steps_actions: Test site in grayscale mode or with color blindness simulator
steps_result: All information must remain comprehensible without relying on color to distinguish elements

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.2 Audio Control
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.2 Audio Control
steps_actions: Load the page and observe whether any audio plays automatically for more than 3 seconds
steps_result: Audio either does not start automatically, stops within 3 seconds, or provides a dedicated mechanism at the top of the page to pause, stop, or mute it independently of system volume

steps_actions: Verify that audio control is keyboard accessible
steps_result: Control must be operable without mouse, using Tab and Enter/Space

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
steps_actions: Verify contrast in all states (normal, hover, focus, disabled)
steps_result: All interactive element states must meet required contrast ratios

steps_actions: Review text over images or gradient backgrounds
steps_result: Overlaid text must have sufficient contrast throughout or use shadows/overlays

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.4 Resize Text
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.4 Resize text
steps_actions: Increase browser zoom and root text size up to 200% and inspect all text containers and meta viewport attributes
steps_result: The meta viewport does not disable user scaling (no user-scalable=no or maximum-scale<2) and all text scales up to 200% without clipping, overlap, or loss of content

steps_actions: Verify that controls and buttons remain operable when zoomed
steps_result: Interactive elements must not be clipped or hidden when text size is increased

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.5 Images of Text
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.5 Images of Text
steps_actions: Identify text rendered as image
steps_result: Text must be in real HTML, not images (except logos or special cases)

steps_actions: Inspect graphics and banners for embedded text
steps_result: Titles, labels, and informative text must be CSS-styled HTML text, not images

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)
steps_actions: Measure foreground-to-background contrast ratios across normal text and large text against AAA thresholds
steps_result: Normal text achieves a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 and large text (>=24px or >=18.66px bold) achieves at least 4.5:1

steps_actions: Document exceptions and plan contrast improvements
steps_result: Identify areas not meeting AAA and prioritize changes in most critical elements

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio
steps_actions: Play audio content and evaluate background sound presence
steps_result: Background audio must be removable, 20dB lower than main audio, or non-existent

steps_actions: Verify control to disable background music if present
steps_result: User must be able to mute or reduce ambient audio without affecting main narration

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.8 Visual Presentation
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.8 Visual Presentation
steps_actions: Verify if user can customize spacing, column width, alignment, and fonts
steps_result: System must allow visual presentation adjustments without loss of functionality or content

steps_actions: Test readability with OS settings (text size, high contrast)
steps_result: Content must respect user preferences defined at system level

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception)
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception)
steps_actions: Thoroughly review entire site for text rendered as images
steps_result: No text in image format must exist, all must be real HTML text (no exceptions except logos)

steps_actions: Inspect decorative elements and verify text is styled with CSS
steps_result: Visual text effects must be achieved with CSS, not by converting text to images

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.10 Reflow
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.10 Reflow
steps_actions: Resize window to 320px width or zoom to 400%
steps_result: Horizontal scrolling must not be required to read content (except complex tables)

steps_actions: Test on real mobile device with narrow viewport
steps_result: All content must adapt fluidly without clipping or need for bidirectional scrolling

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.11 Non-text Contrast
steps_actions: Measure contrast of UI components and focus states
steps_result: Minimum 3:1 contrast for component borders, functional icons, and focus indicators

steps_actions: Verify contrast of informative graphic elements (charts, status icons)
steps_result: Visual elements conveying information must be clearly distinguishable from background

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.12 Text Spacing
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.12 Text Spacing
steps_actions: Apply WCAG text spacing overrides (line-height: 1.5, letter-spacing: 0.12em, word-spacing: 0.16em, paragraph margin-bottom: 2em)
steps_result: All text blocks apply the spacing overrides without being blocked by inline !important styles and without horizontal scroll or clipped text

steps_actions: Verify that buttons and controls do not break with modified spacing
steps_result: Interactive elements must maintain functionality and readability with custom spacing

title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus
description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus
steps_actions: Activate tooltips and popup content with hover and keyboard
steps_result: Additional content must be keyboard accessible, remain visible, and be dismissible without moving pointer

steps_actions: Verify that popup content does not disappear when moving pointer over it
steps_result: User must be able to move cursor over tooltip to read or interact without it disappearing

steps_actions: Verify accessible dismiss mechanism (ESC or close button)
steps_result: Popup content must be dismissible without moving pointer from the trigger that activated it

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.1 Keyboard
description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.1 Keyboard
steps_actions: Test complex components (accordions, tabs, calendars)
steps_result: Custom widgets must respond to appropriate keys (arrows, Home, End, Escape)

steps_actions: Verify all mouse actions have keyboard equivalent
steps_result: Drag and drop, hover menus, touch gestures must have keyboard-operable alternatives

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap
description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap
steps_actions: Navigate the entire page/component using only Tab and Shift+Tab
steps_result: Focus must move through all interactive elements and exit freely without being trapped

steps_actions: Test modals, dialogs, and overlays with keyboard navigation
steps_result: Focus must move freely within the component and it must be closable via Esc or a keyboard-accessible close control

steps_actions: If content requires non-standard keys to exit focus, verify users are informed
steps_result: Instructions for un-trapping focus must be visibly provided

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)
description: Guideline 2.1  Make all functionality available from a keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)
steps_actions: Navigate and operate every interactive component and custom widget using only the keyboard without exception
steps_result: All page functionality is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes

steps_actions: Document functions requiring specific pointer path
steps_result: If function requires specific path (signature, drawing), keyboard alternative or alternative method must exist

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts
description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcut
steps_actions: Identify single-key shortcuts (letter, number, or punctuation) implemented in the interface
steps_result: Each shortcut must be disableable, remappable, or active only while its component has focus

steps_actions: Verify shortcuts do not interfere with screen readers or assistive tools
steps_result: Key combinations must avoid conflicts with assistive technology commands

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.1 Timing Adjustable
steps_actions: Inspect session timeouts, automatic redirects, and meta http-equiv refresh tags on the page
steps_result: No timed meta refresh is present, and any session time limit can be turned off, adjusted to at least 10x the default, or extended with at least 20 seconds notice

steps_actions: Verify prior warning before time expires
steps_result: System must alert with sufficient advance notice and allow simple extension (e.g., press button)

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide
steps_actions: Inspect carousels, auto-updating tickers, animations, and blinking/scrolling content lasting more than 5 seconds
steps_result: No <blink> or <marquee> elements exist, and any moving, blinking, or auto-updating content has a mechanism to pause, stop, or hide it

steps_actions: Verify pause control is visible and keyboard operable
steps_result: Pause/play buttons must be clearly visible and accessible without mouse

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.3 No Timing
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.3 No Timing
steps_actions: Verify that all functionality and content can be used without any time limits
steps_result: Tasks must be completable without time restrictions or interruptions

steps_actions: Document exceptions where time is a real-time requirement
steps_result: Only live essential events (e.g. real-time auctions) may be exempt; all others must have no timing

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.4 Interruptions
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.4 Interruptions
steps_actions: Trigger non-emergency notifications, promotional banners, or automatic page refreshes during a user task
steps_result: Interruptions and non-essential updates can be postponed or suppressed by the user without losing current task progress

steps_actions: Verify notification preferences settings
steps_result: System must offer controls to manage frequency and type of interruptions

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.5 Re-authenticating
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.5 Re-authenticating
steps_actions: Let the session expire mid-task and log in again
steps_result: After re-authenticating, the user must continue the activity without losing previously entered data

steps_actions: Test with long forms and verify data recovery
steps_result: In-progress information must be auto-saved or recoverable after relogin

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.6 Timeouts
description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.6 Timeouts
steps_actions: Verify users are warned about session inactivity timeout
steps_result: A warning must be presented in time for the user to react (at least 20 seconds) via an accessible notification

steps_actions: Verify user can save work before timeout
steps_result: Warning must include a clear option to save progress or extend the session

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold
description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold
steps_actions: Review site animations and transitions
steps_result: No content should flash more than 3 times per second

steps_actions: Use PEAT (Photosensitive Epilepsy Analysis Tool) if available
steps_result: Analyze multimedia content to identify flashes that could cause seizures

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.2 Three Flashes
description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.2 Three Flashes
steps_actions: Thoroughly analyze animations, videos, and dynamic content
steps_result: No flash exceeding safe limits must exist, without exceptions

steps_actions: Review embedded third-party content (ads, external videos)
steps_result: External content must not contain dangerous flashes or must be disableable

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions
description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.3 Animation from Interactions
steps_actions: Verify motion animations triggered by scroll or interaction
steps_result: User must be able to disable non-essential motion animations

steps_actions: Verify respect for system prefers-reduced-motion preference
steps_result: Site must detect and respect OS setting to reduce motion

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.1 Bypass Blocks
steps_actions: Press Tab from the address bar on page load to check for a skip-to-main-content link and verify focus movement
steps_result: A skip link becomes visible on focus and activating it moves keyboard focus directly to the main content container

steps_actions: Verify ARIA landmarks (main, nav, complementary, contentinfo)
steps_result: Structure must use landmark roles to enable quick navigation with screen readers

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.2 Page Titled
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.2 Page Titled
steps_actions: Inspect the document <title> element in the DOM and observe title updates across SPA route changes
steps_result: Every page and view has a non-empty, descriptive <title> element that clearly identifies the current screen or step

steps_actions: Verify title follows consistent format (content - section - site name)
steps_result: Titles must follow predictable pattern facilitating identification in tabs and history

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.3 Focus Order
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.3 Focus Order
steps_actions: Navigate with Tab in order and verify visual logic
steps_result: Focus order must follow logical sequence left to right, top to bottom

steps_actions: Identify elements with positive tabindex and evaluate necessity
steps_result: Avoid tabindex greater than 0, order must be controlled through logical DOM structure

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)
steps_actions: Inspect all <a href>, area[href], and role=link elements to verify their accessible name and destination context
steps_result: Every link has a non-empty accessible name that describes its purpose alone or together with its enclosing sentence/list item, and target=_blank links warn of new window

steps_actions: Use screen reader to list all links
steps_result: Links must be understandable when presented out of context in link list

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.5 Multiple Ways
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.5 Multiple Ways
steps_actions: Try to locate an internal page in different ways
steps_result: Navigation menu, internal search, sitemap, or breadcrumbs must exist

steps_actions: Verify at least two navigation methods are available
steps_result: User must be able to choose between different strategies to locate content

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.6 Headings and Labels
steps_actions: Verify page headings are descriptive and reflect the content structure
steps_result: Each heading must clearly describe the topic or purpose of its section

steps_actions: Use screen reader to navigate by headings
steps_result: Heading structure must allow quick understanding of content organization

steps_actions: Check labels of form fields and interactive controls
steps_result: All labels must be descriptive and clearly identify the control purpose

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.7 Focus Visible
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.7 Focus Visible
steps_actions: Navigate with Tab and observe focus indicator
steps_result: Interactive elements must show clear contrasted visual indicator when focused

steps_actions: Verify outline is not disabled without visual replacement
steps_result: If default outline is removed, equally visible alternative indicator must exist

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.8 Location
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.8 Location
steps_actions: Navigate through different site sections and verify location indicators
steps_result: Breadcrumbs, section titles, or indicators showing user location must exist

steps_actions: Review that breadcrumbs are accessible and reflect correct hierarchy
steps_result: Breadcrumbs must be keyboard navigable and structured with ordered list

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)
steps_actions: Inspect all links on the page in isolation (ignoring surrounding paragraph text) and compare links sharing the same accessible name
steps_result: Each link accessible name uniquely and clearly describes its destination on its own, and links with identical names point to the same resource

steps_actions: Identify generic links ('more info', 'read more') and improve them
steps_result: Ambiguous links must include additional context via aria-label or aria-describedby

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.10 Section Headings
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.10 Section Headings
steps_actions: Review content structure and heading usage
steps_result: Content must be organized with descriptive headings dividing information into logical sections

steps_actions: Verify no long text blocks exist without intermediate headings
steps_result: Extensive content must be subdivided with headings facilitating scanning and navigation

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
steps_actions: Navigate with keyboard and verify focus visibility on elements near edges
steps_result: At least part of focus indicator must remain visible, not completely hidden by other elements

steps_actions: Test navigation in areas with sticky headers or floating elements
steps_result: Sticky bars must not completely cover the focused element

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
steps_actions: Verify focus is completely visible in all situations
steps_result: Focus indicator must be completely visible without any obstruction by other elements

steps_actions: Implement auto-scroll when element receives focus outside viewport
steps_result: Content must auto-adjust to fully show the focused element

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.13 Focus Appearance
description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.13 Focus Appearance
steps_actions: Measure focus indicator area and contrast with specialized tools
steps_result: Indicator must have sufficient minimum area and high contrast for maximum visibility

steps_actions: Calculate that indicator has minimum 2 CSS pixels perimeter or equivalent area
steps_result: Indicator thickness and area must meet specific WCAG 2.2 requirements

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.1 Pointer Gestures
steps_actions: Identify functions activated by complex gestures (swipe, pinch)
steps_result: Functions must have alternative with simple single-point gestures (tap, click)

steps_actions: Verify carousels, maps, and swipeable components
steps_result: Alternative buttons or controls must exist for users with motor limitations

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation
steps_actions: Test activation of interactive elements
steps_result: Function must not execute on mousedown/touchstart, must allow cancellation by releasing outside target

steps_actions: Verify accidental clicks can be cancelled by dragging outside
steps_result: User must be able to undo accidental activation by moving pointer before release

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.3 Label in Name
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.3 Label in Name
steps_actions: Compare the visible text label of every button, link, and form control against its computed accessible name (aria-label / aria-labelledby)
steps_result: For every control with a visible text label, the accessible name contains the exact visible text string (preferably at the beginning)

steps_actions: Verify voice commands can activate controls using visible text
steps_result: Voice control users must be able to say visible text to activate element

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.4 Motion Actuation
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.4 Motion Actuation
steps_actions: Identify functions using accelerometer or gyroscope
steps_result: Functions activated by device motion must have standard UI alternative

steps_actions: Verify setting to disable motion actuation
steps_result: User must be able to disable motion responses to avoid accidental activations

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)
steps_actions: Measure dimensions of all pointer targets (buttons, links, controls)
steps_result: All targets must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels, except inline links within sentences or user-agent controlled elements

steps_actions: Verify exceptions: inline text links, equivalent controls, or legal/presentation requirements
steps_result: If a target is smaller than 44x44, an equivalent alternative control with adequate size must exist

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms
steps_actions: Test site with multiple simultaneous input devices (keyboard + mouse + touch)
steps_result: Site must support simultaneous use of different input mechanisms without restrictions

steps_actions: Verify switching input method does not cause loss of functionality
steps_result: User must be able to freely switch between keyboard, mouse, and touch without issues

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.7 Dragging Movements
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.7 Dragging Movements
steps_actions: Identify drag and drop functions
steps_result: Drag and drop functions must have alternative with simple clicks or taps

steps_actions: Test keyboard alternatives for reordering elements
steps_result: Reorderable lists must be manipulable with keyboard (arrows + Space/Enter)

title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
steps_actions: Measure dimensions of touch controls (buttons, links)
steps_result: Touch targets must have minimum 24x24 CSS pixels or equivalent spacing

steps_actions: Verify spacing between adjacent touch targets
steps_result: If targets are smaller than 24px, sufficient surrounding space must exist to avoid errors

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.1 Language of Page
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.1 Language of Page
steps_actions: Inspect the <html> root element for the lang attribute (and xml:lang if present) in the DOM
steps_result: The <html> element has a non-empty, valid BCP-47 lang attribute matching the primary language of the document (and xml:lang matches if present)

steps_actions: Verify correct pronunciation with screen reader
steps_result: Reader must use voice and pronunciation rules appropriate to declared language

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.2 Language of Parts
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.2 Language of Parts
steps_actions: Locate passages, phrases, or terms written in a language different from the page primary language and inspect their [lang] attribute
steps_result: Every foreign-language passage or phrase (excluding proper names and technical terms) has a valid BCP-47 lang attribute on its container

steps_actions: Test screen reader reading of quotes or terms in another language
steps_result: Language changes must be recognized and pronounced correctly

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.3 Unusual Words
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.3 Unusual Words
steps_actions: Identify jargon, technical terms, or unusual words in content
steps_result: Glossary, inline definitions, or mechanism to explain uncommon terms must exist

steps_actions: Verify accessibility of definitions through links or dfn/abbr elements
steps_result: Specialized terms must link to accessible explanations

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.4 Abbreviations
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.4 Abbreviations
steps_actions: Locate abbreviations and acronyms in content
steps_result: First instance of abbreviations must include full expansion or link to definition

steps_actions: Implement abbr element with title attribute where appropriate
steps_result: Abbreviations must be semantically marked for assistive technologies

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.5 Reading Level
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.5 Reading Level
steps_actions: Evaluate text complexity and required reading level
steps_result: Complex content must have simplified version or summary for lower secondary education level

steps_actions: Use readability analysis tools (Flesch-Kincaid, INFLESZ)
steps_result: Measure readability indices and provide alternatives for technical or complex content

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.6 Pronunciation
description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.6 Pronunciation
steps_actions: Identify words where pronunciation is critical for comprehension
steps_result: Mechanism to indicate pronunciation must exist (IPA, audio, phonetic text)

steps_actions: Verify homographs and ambiguous terms with pronunciation guides
steps_result: Words with multiple pronunciations must be clarified when context is insufficient

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.1 On Focus
description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.1 On Focus
steps_actions: Navigate with Tab through interactive elements
steps_result: No element should cause context change (navigation, submission) just by receiving focus

steps_actions: Verify form fields do not submit when focused
steps_result: Focus must be independent of activation, changes must only occur with explicit action

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.2 On Input
description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.2 On Input
steps_actions: Interact with forms and controls without activating submit button
steps_result: Field changes must not cause context change without prior warning or confirmation

steps_actions: Test selects and radios that may cause automatic navigation
steps_result: If change causes action, prior warning or confirmation button must be required

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation
description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.3 Consistent Navigation
steps_actions: Compare menus and navigation across different pages
steps_result: Repeated navigation elements must appear in same order across all pages

steps_actions: Document location of global elements (search, login, main menu)
steps_result: Common components must maintain consistent position and order throughout site

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.4 Consistent Identification
description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.4 Consistent Identification
steps_actions: Identify components with same function across different pages
steps_result: Equivalent components must use same labels, icons, and accessible names

steps_actions: Verify consistency of icons and symbols throughout site
steps_result: Same icon must represent same function, avoid different symbols for identical actions

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.5 Change on Request
description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.5 Change on Request
steps_actions: Verify significant changes require explicit user action
steps_result: Context changes, submissions, or navigation must not occur without explicit confirmation

steps_actions: Identify and fix automatic submissions or unexpected redirects
steps_result: User must initiate all important changes through clear buttons or links

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.6 Consistent Help
description: Guideline 3.2 Predictable: Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria: 3.2.6 Consistent Help (A) - If a Web page contains help mechanisms, and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple Web pages within a set of Web pages, they occur in the same relative order to other page content, unless a change is initiated by the user.
steps_actions: Search for help mechanisms in different sections
steps_result: Help options must appear in consistent location throughout site

steps_actions: Verify quick access to contact, FAQ, chat, or documentation
steps_result: Help must be available predictably in fixed location

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.1 Error Identification
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.1 Error Identification
steps_actions: Submit form with intentional errors
steps_result: Errors must be clearly identified in text, visually marked, and announced to screen readers

steps_actions: Verify error messages use aria-describedby or aria-invalid
steps_result: Errors must be programmatically associated with affected fields for assistive technologies

steps_actions: Verify focus moves to first error or error summary
steps_result: After validation, user must be clearly directed to found problems

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
steps_actions: Inspect all form controls (inputs, selects, textareas, custom ARIA inputs) for visible labels, required indicators, and format instructions
steps_result: Every data entry control has a persistent visible label programmatically linked to it, and required state or input format constraints are clearly stated before the field

steps_actions: Verify fields with specific formats (date, phone, zip code)
steps_result: Fields with format requirements must include examples or input masks

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.3 Error Suggestion
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.3 Error Suggestion
steps_actions: Trigger validation errors in forms
steps_result: Error messages must suggest how to fix the specific problem

steps_actions: Evaluate message quality: must be specific and solution-oriented
steps_result: Errors must explain what is wrong and how to fix it, not just indicate there is an error

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
steps_actions: Complete financial or legal transactions if they exist
steps_result: Must allow reviewing, confirming, and correcting information before final submission

steps_actions: Verify confirmation page with option to edit before final submission
steps_result: Critical data must be shown in summary with ability to go back and modify

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.5 Help
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.5 Help
steps_actions: Search for contextual help in forms and complex tasks
steps_result: Available help must exist to complete tasks, visible or easily accessible

steps_actions: Verify tooltips, help links, or info icons next to complex fields
steps_result: Help must be available in context where needed, not only on separate page

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.6 Error Prevention (All)
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.6 Error Prevention (All)
steps_actions: Identify forms that modify, delete, or compromise user data
steps_result: Reversible mechanism (undo), verification (review before submit), or explicit confirmation must exist

steps_actions: Test form submission with critical information
steps_result: System must present review screen where user can verify and correct before confirming

steps_actions: Verify availability of option to revert completed actions
steps_result: Destructive actions must allow undo or have grace period before permanent execution

steps_actions: Verify explicit confirmations for irreversible actions
steps_result: Deletions, transfers, or permanent changes must require clear and specific additional confirmation

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.7 Redundant Entry
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.7 Redundant Entry
steps_actions: Complete multi-step forms
steps_result: Previously provided information must auto-complete or be selectable, not re-entered

steps_actions: Verify data from previous steps is pre-filled in later steps
steps_result: User must not re-type name, address, or other already entered data

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
steps_actions: Test login and authentication process
steps_result: Must offer accessible alternatives to visual CAPTCHA or cognitive tests (email, SMS, biometrics)

steps_actions: Verify availability of magic link or OTP code authentication
steps_result: Alternative methods must be equally secure without requiring visual recognition

title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
steps_actions: Test authentication flows to confirm no cognitive function test is required at any step
steps_result: Login must not depend on memorization, transcription, or puzzle solving unless an accessible alternative or assistance is provided

steps_actions: Verify password managers and copy-paste are fully supported in credential fields
steps_result: Users must be able to paste credentials or use password manager autofill/biometrics without restrictions

title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.1 Parsing (Obsolete and removed)
description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.1 Parsing
steps_actions: Check the DOM for duplicate id attributes across active elements, labels, and ARIA IDREF targets
steps_result: All id attribute values in the document and open shadow roots are unique so label[for], aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby references never collide

steps_actions: Review dynamically generated code with browser inspector
steps_result: JavaScript generating content must produce valid and well-formed HTML

title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
steps_actions: Test custom widgets with screen reader
steps_result: Components must announce correctly with appropriate ARIA role, state, and properties
steps_data: axe-core (wcag412): area-alt, aria-allowed-attr, aria-braille-equivalent, aria-command-name, aria-conditional-attr, aria-deprecated-role, aria-hidden-body, aria-hidden-focus, aria-input-field-name, aria-prohibited-attr, aria-required-attr, aria-roles, aria-tab-name, aria-toggle-field-name, aria-tooltip-name, aria-valid-attr-value, aria-valid-attr, button-name, duplicate-id-aria, frame-title-unique, frame-title, input-button-name, input-image-alt, label, link-name, nested-interactive, select-name, summary-name, aria-roledescription

steps_actions: Verify state changes are reflected in ARIA attributes
steps_result: Dynamic states (expanded, selected, pressed) must be updated programmatically

title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.3 Status Messages
description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.3 Status Messages
steps_actions: Trigger dynamic messages (confirmation, error, loading)
steps_result: Messages must be announced in screen readers using appropriate ARIA live regions

steps_actions: Verify correct usage of role=alert, aria-live=polite/assertive
steps_result: Critical messages use assertive, informational use polite, without moving focus

steps_actions: Test with screen reader that announcements interrupt or wait appropriately
steps_result: Live regions must be configured by message urgency without causing excessive interruptions
